info.name: Lufthansa LH Public Cargo Operations API

params.name: flightNumber
params.description: Flight number including carrier code and any suffix (e.g. 'LH400')

params.name: date
params.description: The departure date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the local time of the departure airport

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per request. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100 (if a value bigger than 100 is given, 100 will be taken)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records skipped. Defaults to 0

items.docs: Status of a particular flight (boarding, delayed, etc.).

params.name: origin
params.description: 3-letter IATA airport (e.g. 'FRA')

params.name: destination
params.description: 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g. 'JFK')

params.name: date
params.description: Departure date (YYYY-MM-DD) in local time of departure airport

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per request. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100 (if a value bigger than 100 is given, 100 will be taken)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records skipped. Defaults to 0

items.docs: Status of flights between a given origin and destination on a given date.

info.name: Lufthansa Flight Status at Arrival Airport

params.name: airportCode
params.description: 3-letter IATA aiport code (e.g. 'ZRH')

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Start of time range in local time of arrival airport (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per request. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100 (if a value bigger than 100 is given, 100 will be taken)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records skipped. Defaults to 0

items.docs: Status of all arrivals at a given airport up to 4 hours from the provided date time.

info.name: Lufthansa Flight Status at Departure Airport

params.name: airportCode
params.description: Departure airport. 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g. 'HAM')

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Start of time range in local time of departure airport (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per request. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100 (if a value bigger than 100 is given, 100 will be taken)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records skipped. Defaults to 0

items.docs: Status of all departures from a given airport up to 4 hours from the provided date time.

params.name: origin
params.description: Departure airport. 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g. 'ZRH')

params.name: destination
params.description: Destination airport. 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g. 'FRA')

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Local departure date and optionally departure time (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm). When not provided, time is assumed to be 00:01

params.name: directFlights
params.description: Show only direct flights (false=0, true=1). Default is false

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per request. Defaults to 20, maximum is 100 (if a value bigger than 100 is given, 100 will be taken)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records skipped. Defaults to 0

items.docs: Scheduled flights between given airports on a given date.
